verdict.rationale: Yapily's Data API clearly supports pulling account transactions via a dedicated endpoint (get-account-transactions) under consented access, and webhooks exist for real-time notifications of platform changes. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of pagination parameters, no stated history depth/lookback window, and no explicit sync/delta pattern for fetching only changed transactions since a webhook or polling cursor. missing for 10: pagination parameter docs, transaction history depth/retention window, explicit incremental-sync (delta) pattern tied to transactions.
